name: Long Ring contest
entry:
Long Ring contest (Invented Test Game)
Two teams take turns casting a woven ring toward a post set some paces off. A cast that lands true scores two and a cast that touches scores one. Players throw from behind a scratched line. The first side to reach the agreed count wins the round. Where a cast is disputed the eldest player present decides.

name: Short Stick making game
entry:
Short Stick making game (Invented Test Game)
Before play each child shapes a carved stick from material gathered nearby. How well it is shaped decides how it travels, so the making is half the game. The shaped pieces are then used against a pit in turn, and the best of three casts carries the round. Younger children play a shortened form with fewer rounds.

name: High Marble solitary round
entry:
High Marble solitary round (Invented Test Game)
A single player sets out a clay marble and works through a fixed order of moves toward a circle. There is no opponent and no winner; a run either closes correctly or it does not, and the player may begin again at once. The game is played outdoors in the dry season.

name: Low Rope chase
entry:
Low Rope chase (Invented Test Game)
One player is chosen by a counting rhyme and pursues the rest within a marked field. A player caught joins the pursuit. Play ends when one remains free, and that player begins the next round. Where a cast is disputed the eldest player present decides.
